data.text:
Ashiq E.S vs Food Safety Officer Kodungallur Circle on 19
March, 2024
Author: Bechu Kurian Thomas 
Bench: Bechu Kurian Thomas Crl.MC No.1821/2022 1/1  IN THE HIGH COURT OF KERALA AT ERNAKULAM  PRESENT  THE HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE BECHU KURIAN THOMAS  Tuesday, the 19th day of March 2024 / 29th Phalguna, 1945  CRL.M.APPL.NO.1/2022 IN CRL.MC NO. 1821 OF 2022 CC 1036/2021 COURT OF JUDICIAL MAGISTRATE OF FIRST CLASS - I, CHALAKUDY,
THRISSUR  APPLICANTS/PETITIONERS/PETITIONERS/ACCUSED NOS 1 TO 7:
 ASHIQ E.S., AGED 28 YEARS ,ERAMASRYILLATH HOUSE, VADAMA P.O., PIN  680732, PIN - 680732 AND 6 OTHERS  RESPONDENTS/COMPLAINANT,STATE & ANOTHER:
 FOOD SAFETY OFFICER KODUNGALLUR CIRCLE OFFICE OF FOOD SAFETY OFFICER  KODUNGALLUR CIRCLE, PIN - 680664 AND 2 OTHERS  Application praying that in the circumstances stated therein  the High Court be pleased to stay all further proceedings in  C.C.1036/2021 pending on the files of the Judicial First Class  Magistrate, Chalakudy, pending disposal of the above Criminal  Miscellaneous Case. 
 This Application again coming on for orders upon perusing the  application and this court's order dated 20/09/2023 in Crl.MA  No.1/2022 and upon hearing the arguments of M/S.PREMJIT NAGENDRAN,
 Advocate for the petitioners, and of and PUBLIC PROSECUTOR for the  1st and 2nd respondents, SHRI.SANTHAN V. NAIR Standing Counsel, for  the 3rd respondent the court passed the following:
 ORDER Interim order shall stand extended by three months.
Sd/- BECHU KURIAN THOMAS JUDGE 19-03-2024 /True Copy/ Assistant Registrar Ashiq E.S vs Food Safety Officer Kodungallur Circle on 19 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185321607/
